name: ansible-automation
label: Ansible Automation
description: Executes Ansible playbooks, ad-hoc modules, and roles directly from FortiSOAR playbooks using ansible-runner, returning structured per-host and per-task results. Ansible is agentless, so this connector drives remote hosts over SSH or WinRM without requiring a separate Ansible Automation Platform deployment.

fields.name: default_inventory
fields.title: Default Inventory
fields.description: Specify the inventory used when a playbook step does not supply one, as YAML, INI, or a JSON object. Leave blank to default to implicit localhost.
fields.tooltip: Specify the inventory used when a playbook step does not supply one, as YAML, INI, or a JSON object. Leave blank to default to implicit localhost.

fields.name: ssh_username
fields.title: SSH Username
fields.description: Specify the default user to connect to remote hosts as.
fields.tooltip: Specify the default user to connect to remote hosts as.

fields.name: ssh_private_key
fields.title: SSH Private Key
fields.description: Specify the PEM-encoded private key used to connect to remote hosts. The key is written to a run-scoped file with owner-only permissions and removed when the run completes.
fields.tooltip: Specify the PEM-encoded private key used to connect to remote hosts. The key is written to a run-scoped file with owner-only permissions and removed when the run completes.

fields.name: ssh_password
fields.title: SSH Password
fields.description: Specify the password used to connect to remote hosts, as an alternative to a private key. The password is supplied to Ansible through its prompt channel and never appears on the command line.
fields.tooltip: Specify the password used to connect to remote hosts, as an alternative to a private key. The password is supplied to Ansible through its prompt channel and never appears on the command line.

fields.name: become
fields.title: Become
fields.description: Select this option to escalate privileges on remote hosts.
fields.tooltip: Select this option to escalate privileges on remote hosts.

fields.name: become_method
fields.title: Become Method
fields.description: Select the privilege escalation method to use when Become is selected.
fields.tooltip: Select the privilege escalation method to use when Become is selected.

fields.name: become_user
fields.title: Become User
fields.description: Specify the user to escalate to. Leave blank to escalate to root.
fields.tooltip: Specify the user to escalate to. Leave blank to escalate to root.

fields.name: become_password
fields.title: Become Password
fields.description: Specify the password used for privilege escalation, if one is required.
fields.tooltip: Specify the password used for privilege escalation, if one is required.

fields.name: host_key_checking
fields.title: Verify Host Keys
fields.description: Specifies whether the SSH host keys of remote hosts are to be verified against the connector's known_hosts file. Clearing this option disables host key verification.
fields.tooltip: Specifies whether the SSH host keys of remote hosts are to be verified against the connector's known_hosts file. Clearing this option disables host key verification.

fields.name: collections_path
fields.title: Collections Path
fields.description: Specify an absolute path in which Ansible collections are installed and resolved from. Leave blank to use the connector's default path.
fields.tooltip: Specify an absolute path in which Ansible collections are installed and resolved from. Leave blank to use the connector's default path.

fields.name: default_timeout
fields.title: Default Timeout
fields.description: Specify the maximum number of seconds a run may take before it is terminated, used when a playbook step does not specify its own timeout.
fields.tooltip: Specify the maximum number of seconds a run may take before it is terminated, used when a playbook step does not specify its own timeout.

fields.name: forks
fields.title: Forks
fields.description: Specify the number of hosts Ansible configures in parallel.
fields.tooltip: Specify the number of hosts Ansible configures in parallel.

fields.name: verbosity
fields.title: Verbosity
fields.description: Select the default Ansible verbosity level.
fields.tooltip: Select the default Ansible verbosity level.

fields.name: run_retention_hours
fields.title: Run Retention (Hours)
fields.description: Specify the number of hours retained run directories are kept for before they are removed.
fields.tooltip: Specify the number of hours retained run directories are kept for before they are removed.

operations.title: Run Playbook
operations.description: Executes an Ansible playbook supplied inline, read from a path on the FortiSOAR node, or cloned from a git repository, and returns the per-host and per-task results.

parameters.name: source_type
parameters.title: Source Type
parameters.description: Select where the playbook comes from: inline YAML, an absolute path on the FortiSOAR node, or a git repository.
parameters.tooltip: Select where the playbook comes from: inline YAML, an absolute path on the FortiSOAR node, or a git repository.

parameters.name: playbook
parameters.title: Playbook
parameters.description: Specify the playbook. For the inline source type this is the playbook YAML itself; for the path source type an absolute path; for the git source type the path to the playbook within the repository.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the playbook. For the inline source type this is the playbook YAML itself; for the path source type an absolute path; for the git source type the path to the playbook within the repository.

parameters.name: git_repo
parameters.title: Git Repository
parameters.description: Specify the repository URL to clone when the source type is git.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the repository URL to clone when the source type is git.

parameters.name: git_branch
parameters.title: Git Branch
parameters.description: Specify the branch to clone when the source type is git. Leave blank for the default branch.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the branch to clone when the source type is git. Leave blank for the default branch.

parameters.name: git_token
parameters.title: Git Token
parameters.description: Specify an access token for a private http(s) repository. Leave blank to use the SSH key from the connector configuration.
parameters.tooltip: Specify an access token for a private http(s) repository. Leave blank to use the SSH key from the connector configuration.

parameters.name: inventory
parameters.title: Inventory
parameters.description: Specify the inventory to run against, as YAML, INI, or a JSON object. Leave blank to use the default inventory from the connector configuration, or implicit localhost if that is also blank.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the inventory to run against, as YAML, INI, or a JSON object. Leave blank to use the default inventory from the connector configuration, or implicit localhost if that is also blank.

parameters.name: extra_vars
parameters.title: Extra Variables
parameters.description: Specify extra variables to pass to the play, as a JSON object. Equivalent to ansible-playbook --extra-vars.
parameters.tooltip: Specify extra variables to pass to the play, as a JSON object. Equivalent to ansible-playbook --extra-vars.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.title: Limit
parameters.description: Specify a host pattern to restrict the run to a subset of the inventory. Equivalent to --limit.
parameters.tooltip: Specify a host pattern to restrict the run to a subset of the inventory. Equivalent to --limit.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.title: Tags
parameters.description: Specify a comma-separated list of tags. Only tasks carrying these tags run. Equivalent to --tags.
parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of tags. Only tasks carrying these tags run. Equivalent to --tags.

parameters.name: skip_tags
parameters.title: Skip Tags
parameters.description: Specify a comma-separated list of tags whose tasks are skipped. Equivalent to --skip-tags.
parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of tags whose tasks are skipped. Equivalent to --skip-tags.

parameters.name: check_mode
parameters.title: Check Mode
parameters.description: Select this option to run without making changes, i.e. a dry run. Equivalent to --check.
parameters.tooltip: Select this option to run without making changes, i.e. a dry run. Equivalent to --check.

parameters.name: diff
parameters.title: Diff
parameters.description: Select this option to return the differences that would be applied to changed files. Equivalent to --diff.
parameters.tooltip: Select this option to return the differences that would be applied to changed files. Equivalent to --diff.

parameters.name: verbosity
parameters.title: Verbosity
parameters.description: Select the Ansible verbosity level for this run. Leave at Default to inherit the connector configuration.
parameters.tooltip: Select the Ansible verbosity level for this run. Leave at Default to inherit the connector configuration.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.title: Timeout
parameters.description: Specify the maximum number of seconds this run may take before it is terminated. Leave blank to use the connector configuration default.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the maximum number of seconds this run may take before it is terminated. Leave blank to use the connector configuration default.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.title: Wait For Completion
parameters.description: Select this option to block until the run finishes and return the full result. Clear it to start the run asynchronously and return an identifier you can poll with Get Run Status.
parameters.tooltip: Select this option to block until the run finishes and return the full result. Clear it to start the run asynchronously and return an identifier you can poll with Get Run Status.

parameters.name: keep_artifacts
parameters.title: Keep Artifacts
parameters.description: Select this option to retain the run directory after completion so that Get Run Artifacts can read it. Retained runs are removed after the configured retention period.
parameters.tooltip: Select this option to retain the run directory after completion so that Get Run Artifacts can read it. Retained runs are removed after the configured retention period.

operations.title: Get Run Status
operations.description: Retrieves the current status, return code, and statistics of a run started asynchronously, based on the run identifier you have specified.

parameters.name: ident
parameters.title: Run Identifier
parameters.description: Specify the identifier returned when the run was started.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the identifier returned when the run was started.

operations.title: Get Run Artifacts
operations.description: Retrieves the full event stream, standard output, and gathered fact cache of a retained run, based on the run identifier you have specified.

parameters.title: Run Identifier
parameters.description: Specify the identifier of a run that was executed with Keep Artifacts selected.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the identifier of a run that was executed with Keep Artifacts selected.

operations.title: Cancel Run

parameters.name: ident

parameters.description: Specify the identifier of the run to terminate.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the identifier of the run to terminate.
